# S-Bike Training Hub

> Free, open-source, local training hub for cycling, running, swimming and lifting, on macOS, Windows or Linux, with an MCP server so an AI assistant can set the athlete up, read their training and plan it with them. Optional smart-bike bridge (tested on the Merach S29: ERG, virtual gears, hills, routes). Records stay on the athlete's computer.

Install everything in one line (needs uv): `claude mcp add --scope user s-bike-hub -- uvx s-bike-training-hub@latest`. The MCP server starts the hub app (http://127.0.0.1:8729) when it isn't running. Claude Desktop: `{"mcpServers": {"s-bike-hub": {"command": "uvx", "args": ["s-bike-training-hub@latest"]}}}`. Or clone the repository and run its setup script.

## For an AI assistant

- Start a new athlete with `get_setup_status` and follow its next step, one question at a time: basics, a short health check, sports and experience, current routine, goal/time/days, then the program and the first week.
- Plan in two passes with `get_planning_context`: scope=program places placeholder sessions for the season (preview_program); scope=week drafts the coming week's workouts (preview_coaching_change kind=calendar). Show every draft and apply only after the athlete approves.
- Read the brief first: get_planning_context answers with at_a_glance and an index of sections; ask for a section (and one sport) only when needed. get_guide(topic) holds the detailed rules.
- Lifting: design_lift_session composes a session by type (groups), duration (exercises per group), intensity (% of each lift's estimated max; never maxing) and style, and suggests intensity from the athlete's own responses; describe_lift_structure returns the label.
- Holds come only from the athlete's reports (unresolved symptoms, a sore check-in) or their own choices; model readings are evidence. Health and history records are the athlete's own guidance: never diagnose or clear anyone.

## MCP server

- Package `s-bike-training-hub` on PyPI (command `s-bike-training-hub`); also a `.mcpb` bundle on GitHub releases. Registry name `io.github.JHarp199345/s-bike-hub`. Standard library only; stdio transport.
